name: Mulberry
siboNotes: Mulberries are well-tolerated on SIBO diets as they're low in fermentable carbohydrates and unlikely to feed bacterial overgrowth.
preparationTips: Fresh mulberries are best consumed within 2-3 days of picking
Rinse gently just before eating to preserve delicate texture
Can be frozen for later use in smoothies or baking
Dried mulberries are more concentrated in sugars - use smaller portions
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin C for immune support
Good source of iron and potassium
